jobs.description: Keep logistics moving as a Logistics Coordinator in Lelystad. In this role, you are at the heart of a modern, high tech logistics operation, coordinating daily transport flows and making sure everything runs smoothly. Wie zoeken we? As a Logistics Coordinator, you are organised, communicative and able to stay calm when things change. You enjoy working in a dynamic warehouse environment and know how to keep an overview when priorities shift. You are also comfortable communicating with drivers, carriers and internal teams and represent the organisation professionally at all times. MBO+ level of working and thinking, preferably in Logistics or Supply Chain 1 to 3 years of experience in a logistics, transport or warehouse environment Experience with ERP or WMS systems such as SAP is an advantage Good command of English, both written and spoken Valid driver’s license and own transportation Wat bieden wij je? You will work in a modern logistics environment in Lelystad, where collaboration, accuracy and continuous improvement are key. There is plenty of room to develop yourself through training and learning opportunities. Monthly salary €2,607 to €3,349 excluding shift allowance 25 vacation days based on a 40 hour work week Option to purchase one extra week of leave and three additional healthy days Company laptop and phone for business and private use Pension plan, discount on gym membership and bike plan, active staff association This is a role in two shifts Functieomschrijving As a Logistics Coordinator, you are responsible for the accurate and efficient handling of transport processes at the Lelystad site. You monitor daily inbound and outbound transport flows, coordinate arrivals and departures and make sure all administrative records are complete and accurate. You work closely with Operations, Warehouse Support and other internal stakeholders and report directly to the Supervisor. You are also an important point of contact for carriers and drivers. From welcomingdrivers when they arrive to assigning the correct dock or gate, you make sure the transport process runs as efficiently as possible. Coordinating and monitoring inbound and outbound transport movements Maintaining contact with carriers, drivers and internal stakeholders regarding shipment status Welcoming and assisting drivers during arrival and departure Assigning the correct dock or gate position to incoming trucks Checking and processing transport documentation Identifying and following up on deviations in transport and logistics processes Preparing reports and processing operational data in systems and Excel Supporting smooth and efficient daily logistics operations Where will you work? As a Logistics Employee, you will join an international logistics organization specializing in supply chain management and e-commerce. At the Lelystad location, a modern warehouse environment is being developed, with automation and technology playing a key role. The site is part of a larger international organization with thousands of employees and locations worldwide. Within this new operation, logistics, data, and automated processes come together. This makes it an exciting environment for a Supervisor who likes to look beyond the day-to-day planning. You will also have the opportunity to help build the operation from the ground up. Together with your colleagues, you will develop efficient ways of working, build strong teams, and create a warehouse operation that is ready for further growth.
